speaker: BLUEARCADIA PORT AUTHORITY
text: We welcome the wind park, as it can help the port become more sustainable and contribute to SDG 9.

speaker: BLUEARCADIA PORT AUTHORITY
text: We are concerned about competitiveness. If ships need to make a detour to reach us, they may prefer Babylonia's port instead.

speaker: BLUEARCADIA PORT AUTHORITY
text: Arcadia could lose its position as a global transport hub, affecting SDG 8 and long-term infrastructure planning.
